mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour BTC close crossing its documented ten-period Zero Lag Exponential Moving Average identifies a trend change after compensating the input for conventional moving-average lag; follow the new relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when close crosses strictly above ZLEMA(10); short when close crosses strictly below it
mechanism.why_distinct: ZLEMA first advances close by subtracting its rounded four-bar delayed value, then applies a ten-period EMA. It is not an ordinary EMA/SMA, HMA/ALMA turn, oscillator, channel, range path, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: lag compensation is designed to react to directional changes without waiting for a conventional average, while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour price crossings of a lag-compensated recursive trend estimate are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.delayed_close: completed close four valid decisions earlier
features.zlema: LEAN EMA(10) of adjusted close, seeded by the first ten adjusted inputs
features.event: current close newly strictly above finite ZLEMA from not above gives +1; newly strictly below from not below gives -1
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: delay, EMA, and crossover state reset after any invalid completed four-hour bar

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official ZLEMA(10) price crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, delay rounding, EMA seed, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John Ehlers and Ric Way Zero Lag Exponential Moving Average; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation
external_basis.fixed_definition: documented period 10; lag=round((10-1)/2)=4 under LEAN/.NET midpoint-to-even rounding; adjusted input=close+(close-close delayed four decisions); EMA(10) with LEAN SMA seed then recursive alpha=2/11; readiness after 15 uninterrupted bars
external_basis.selection_use: official formula, documented example period, readiness, and standard price/average crossover only; no incidence or outcomes
